template.free_leaf: primitive 'p': a rule template reads uniform 'zz': only its inputs, the incoming adjoint and the input tangents may be free in a rule (['$dot0', '$in0', '$out'])
template.free_leaf_in_loop: primitive 'p': a rule template reads uniform 'zz' inside a loop body: only its inputs, the incoming adjoint and the input tangents may be free in a rule (['$dot0', '$in0', '$out'])
template.index_outside: primitive 'p': a rule template reads the index or a carry of a loop outside that loop
template.carry_outside: primitive 'p': a rule template reads the index or a carry of a loop outside that loop
template.tape_read: primitive 'p': a rule template may not read a tape (it belongs to a loop outside the template)
template.body_sinks: primitive 'p': a loop in a rule template may not write a plane (it has body sinks)
template.edges_outside: primitive 'p': a rule template may not hold a reduce node (it holds edges outside a loop)
